construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit H25-043 (Site Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2025), status Preparing for Hearin: "Site Development permit to allow construction of 2 buildings containing a total of 12 residential condominiums on an approximately 0.46-gross-acre site. Associated with MUN GP Amendment File No. GP25-005 and Rezoning File C26-002. 1030 and 1038 McKendrie" (city text cut off at 255 characters)
City of San Jose permit PRE25-489 (Prelim - Focused (Policy Review, No Plans), folder year 2025), status Complete: "SB330 preapplication to construct 12 townhomes"
City of San Jose permit T25-026 (Tentative Map, folder year 2025), status Under Review: "Tentative map for future 12 townhome development"

Draft MND (SCH 2026080193): merge parcels at 1030 and 1038 McKendrie Street (APNs 230-42-014 and 230-42-013), demolish the existing surface parking lot and development, and build two multi-family buildings with 12 three-story townhome-style units, each with an attached ground-floor garage; one 26-foot driveway from McKendrie Street, a private internal road serving the garages, and six visitor parking spaces. Requires a General Plan Amendment to Mixed Use Neighborhood and a rezoning. Existing zoning listed as Single-Family Residential and Commercial Pedestrian. Cross streets McKendrie and Myrtle. Lead agency contact: Charlotte Yuen, Planner II; environmental consultant Rincon Consultants.
City of San Jose permit layer lists Martin Menne (MCM Diversified) as applicant on GP25-005, ER25-107, PRE25-489, H25-043, T25-026 and ER26-019.
